title: Baa Juice Strawberry Cherry Raspberry 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Baa Juice Strawberry Cherry Raspberry Nic Salt combines three berry favourites in one vibrant mix. Sweet Strawberry sets the tone, juicy Cherry adds richness, and tangy Raspberry sharpens the finish, creating a layered fruit flavour that stays lively and satisfying. Part of the Baa Juice Bar Salts collection, this e-liquid is formulated with double-concentrated flavour to capture the strong taste associated with bar-style vapes. With a 50VG/50PG ratio, it’s designed for Mouth-To-Lung (MTL) vaping, ensuring bright flavour delivery, discreet vapour, and a smooth throat hit. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, Baa Juice Strawberry Cherry Raspberry is a versatile berry mix that pairs perfectly with refillable vapes and starter vape kits .
